If sentiment is strongly bullish (≥0.75) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is strongly bearish (≤-0.75) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to counteract pessimism.  
For mid-horizon (8–15 days), if sentiment is neutral (0.25–0.75), apply a 0.5–1.0% downward adjustment if recent price trend is declining.  
For late-horizon (16–30 days), if sentiment is bullish but price is trending downward, apply a 1.0–2.0% upward adjustment to align with sentiment momentum.  
If sentiment shifts from bullish to bearish within 3 days, reduce forecast by 2.0–3.0% for the next 5 days to reflect sentiment reversal.  
If sentiment is consistently neutral or mixed (±0.25) and price is volatile, apply a 0.5–1.5% smoothing filter across all horizons to dampen noise.
